verdict.why: The fake timers update adds Temporal mocking, which changes what fake timers affect.

draft.detail: Temporal is faked when it is available on the global object.

test.error: FAIL: Temporal.Now.instant() returned the real time under vi.useFakeTimers()

source.quote: `Temporal` is only faked when it is available on the global object: natively (Node.js >= 26 by default, behind `--harmony-temporal` on older versions, and supporting browsers) or through a globally installed polyfill such as `import 'temporal-polyfill/global'`.
